newsitem.title: INDIA: Eighteen killed in Nepal bus accident.
newsitem.headline: Eighteen killed in Nepal bus accident.

text.p: Eighteen people were killed and some 35 injured in a bus accident in western Nepal, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said on Wednesday.
The accident occurred on Tuesday in Lamjung district, the news agency, monitored in the Indian capital, said.
The bus was headed towards Beshishahur town, about 100 km (60 miles) west of the Himalayan kingdom's capital Kathmandu, PTI said.
No other details were immediately available, it said.
